description: A React component class 'DialogElement' for rendering various types of dialog input elements (text, textarea, select, bool, radio) with associated logic for handling selections and rendering different input types based on props.

classes.name: DialogElement
classes.description: A React.PureComponent class that renders dialog input elements based on props, managing internal state for select inputs and handling user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting up providers based on props.type and dataSource, and default value.

methods.name: handleSelected
methods.description: Handles selection from autocomplete/select inputs, updating parent via onChange and internal state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate input component based on the 'type' prop, including text, textarea, select, bool, and radio inputs.
